sources.note: Entity designer help page; WebFetch extraction (paraphrase)

claims.statement: New entities can be created from the JPA Structure tab.
claims.supports: create a new entity from the JPA Structure tab
claims.surfaceEquivalent: Headless on the Persistence view surface: toolbar Add button (a pick list of Entity, JPA Converter, Hibernate Custom Type, Spring Data Repository, DTO, Projection, Persistence Unit) and the right-click New submenu create a new entity through the reviewed non-overwriting flow (RS-814, RS-815). Not checked: the Add button glyph or dropdown drawing (OpenIDEA toolbar buttons have no dropdown) and the tool window layout.

claims.statement: Adding in JPA Structure offers a JPA Converter or Hibernate CustomType.
claims.supports: select JPA Converter or Hibernate CustomType
claims.surfaceEquivalent: Headless on the BEHAVIOUR: our plugin offers a JPA attribute converter (code action 'Create attribute converter with preview…') and a Hibernate custom type (code action 'Create Hibernate user type…') for an entity attribute. Not checked: the original's Add button in the JPA Structure tool window and a single shared chooser; ours are two separate editor actions, and the Persistence view toolbar Add list now offers both in one list (RS-816, RS-817); the dropdown drawing is not checked.
